title: Victor George Bailey and Louis Grover Martin - Wellington Crash, Ford
memorial_details:
description: Royal Air Force
In memory of 
Sergeant Victor George Bailey,
1585910, Royal Air Force Volunteer Reserve.
Wireless Operator, aged 20 yrs.
Of Rainham, Essex
And
Seargent Louis Grover Martin,
R/182617, Royal Canadian Air Force, 
Rear Gunner, aged 22 yrs.
of Big River, Saskatchewan,
Canada

Who died when their Wellington Bomber 
Crashed in Ford 
On 9th January, 1944.
